## Summary

P25.5 live-operations expansion — the **field-level extraction half** of the amended
ticket, stacked on `devin/deploy-gcp-live`. The previously landed document-capture path
(P25.5 first run) turned approved sources into evidence artifacts; this run converts
captured bytes into typed, located, provenance-carrying claims — fail-closed on drift,
aggregate-only where mandated, and honest about every refusal.

## What changed

### Shared parsing layer (`parsing/document.py`, new)
Pure, post-capture byte extraction used by every adapter: `html_text`, `html_links`,
`pdf_text_pages` (new `pypdf` dep; fail-closed — malformed/encrypted/non-PDF/image-only
bytes yield no text), `utf8_text`, `byte_range_locator`, `page_locator_for`. No network,
no capture access beyond the bytes handed in.

### Framework
- `Connector.discover_more` + `RunContext.resolved_targets`: an adapter may resolve a
  bounded set of child targets (linked filings, prefecture PDFs) at parse time; the
  pipeline runs **one** continuation pass (max-depth=1 — no recursive fan-out).
- Per-child politeness refusals recorded on the fetch record (`refusals[]`) without
  aborting; a seed-target refusal still aborts (`politeness_refusal` → exit 6). Child
  fetch failures record `link_rotted` disappearances + a research task. `ContentDrift`
  → zero claims, recorded, re-raised.

### France/Belgium (`france_belgium.py`)
- `raa_prefectures`: strict CSV shape (changed required header → `ContentDrift`);
  arrêté-like title **and** PDF-URL **and** https **and** departement bounds;
  `max_documents=8` — the adapter can never fan out to the ~23k archive. Child PDFs
  classified through P07.1; `LegalInstrument` rows carry
  `instrument_type=fr.arrete_prefectoral`, index-row locators, and the CSI L252
  five-year derived sunset (marked `derived`) when no explicit expiry exists.
- `madada`: strict Atom shape; safe fields only (`id`/`published`/`updated`/`link`) →
  `fr.cada` records-request contexts. `<title>/<content>/<summary>/<author>` are in the
  never-emit contract — request text is never read, retained, or emitted.
- `declarationcamera_be`: stays NoLiveTargets — the register sits behind Belgian eID;
  HG-04 owed, not bypassed.

### CCOPS (`government_mandated_disclosure.py`)
`index_page` captures discover spec-matching filing links (per-source reviewed specs,
`max_documents`-bounded); `disclosure_document` filings extract typed claims —
ordinance citation + enacting body, technology derived from the filing's own
title/filename, legal authority, retention literal, per-section
`disclosure_field_state` (answered / present_but_empty / absent — mandated ≠
populated). The aggregate-only schema gate, use-predicate allowlist, and
procured≠deployed guard are all still enforced; forbidden person/plate-level fields
are suppressed and counted, never emitted.

### Pathways (`pathways.py`)
Captured documents are read at the P07.1 layer (`pdf_text`/`selector_template`);
genre is re-derived from the bytes (never the configured label); reviewed-literal
`technology` claims emit only where the document's own text carries them; `deployed`
still requires a deployment-report genre. Per-document `license_spdx` rides every
artifact.
